title: Evaluation and the mechanism of ShengXian and JinShuiLiuJun decoction in the treatment of silicotic fibrosis: An integrated network pharmacology, life omics, and experimental validation study.
authors: Tang, Yiwen; Wu, Bingbing; Zhao, Liyuan; Gao, Yan; Shen, Xi; Xiao, Shuyu; Yao, Sanqiao; Liu, Jinchao; Qi, Huisheng; Shen, Fuhai
one_liner_zh: 该研究聚焦中药复方治疗矽肺纤维化的网络药理学与多组学机制，虽含分子对接但核心是炎症通路与纤维化，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Silicosis is a systemic disease characterized by extensive fibrosis due to prolonged exposure to silica dust, with rising incidence rates significantly impacting global public health. ShengXian and JinShuiLiuJun Decoction (SXD) is a Chinese medicinal preparation containing a variety of medicinal plants. It has shown notable clinical efficacy in treating silicotic fibrosis in China. However, the precise mechanisms underlying its therapeutic effects remain unclear. This study integrates network pharmacology, multi-omics analysis, and experimental validation to investigate the potential mechanisms by which SXD treats silicotic fibrosis. OBJECTIVE: The study aims to investigate the therapeutic efficacy of SXD in treating silicotic fibrosis and to elucidate its underlying molecular mechanisms. METHODS: HPLC-Q-TOF-MS was used to identify the active components of SXD, and combined with network pharmacology, metabolomics, and transcriptomics, the mechanism of SXD in treating silicotic fibrosis was explored from multiple perspectives. The therapeutic effect of SXD was assessed through HE staining, Masson staining, Micro CT imaging, pulmonary function tests, and hydroxyproline content in lung tissue. Finally, network pharmacology and multi-omics findings were validated using molecular docking. CETSA, immunofluorescence, SPR, and Western blotting were used to analyze key factors in the NF-kappaB pathway at the animal, cellular, and molecular levels. RESULTS: SXD treatment improved lung function in silicosis rats, reduced inflammatory cell infiltration, collagen deposition, fibrosis and other pathological changes, and inhibited the protein expression of TNF-alpha, IL-17A, and IL-1beta, and NF-kappaB in lung tissue. HPLC-Q-TOF-MS combined with network pharmacology identified key compounds such as Liquiritigenin, 3-Methoxynobiletin, Isomangiferin, Hesperidin, shogaol, and Ligustroflavone, which likely exert therapeutic effects through the TNF, IL-17, NF-kappaB, and TGF-beta signaling pathways. Transcriptomics and metabolomics results revealed that SXD up-regulated the expression of NF-kappaB pathway-related genes (NFKBIA, NFKBIZ) and key regulators of the retinol metabolism pathway, while down-regulating pro-inflammatory genes (IL1B, IL17A, IL6). Experimental findings confirmed that SXD suppressed the expression of NF-kappaB pathway-related proteins and upstream activators TNF-alpha, IL-17A, and IL-1beta, as well as their receptors, in both lung tissue and cellular models. Additionally, SXD-containing serum had a direct, non-toxic effect on MRC-5 cells, effectively inhibiting collagen expression and TGF-beta secretion. SXD also had a positive effect on collagen production and extracellular matrix (ECM) aggregation in fibroblasts. Molecular dynamics studies showed that SXD directly binds to NF-kappaB and IkappaB. CONCLUSION: SXD exerts therapeutic effects on silicotic fibrosis by inhibiting NF-kappaB signaling transduction mediated by TNF-alpha, IL-17A, and IL-1beta, and suppressing fibroblast activation.
abstract_zh: 背景：矽肺是一种因长期暴露于二氧化硅粉尘而导致的以广泛纤维化为特征的系统性疾病，其发病率不断上升，对全球公共卫生造成显著影响。参仙和金水六君煎（SXD）是一种含有多种药用植物的中药制剂，在中国治疗矽肺纤维化方面显示出显著的临床疗效。然而，其治疗作用的确切机制仍不清楚。本研究整合网络药理学、多组学分析和实验验证，探讨SXD治疗矽肺纤维化的潜在机制。目的：本研究旨在考察SXD治疗矽肺纤维化的疗效，并阐明其潜在的分子机制。方法：采用HPLC-Q-TOF-MS鉴定SXD的活性成分，并结合网络药理学、代谢组学和转录组学，从多角度探讨SXD治疗矽肺纤维化的机制。通过HE染色、Masson染色、Micro CT成像、肺功能测试和肺组织中羟脯氨酸含量评估SXD的治疗效果。最后，利用分子对接验证网络药理学和多组学发现。采用CETSA、免疫荧光、SPR和Western blotting在动物、细胞和分子水平分析NF-kappaB通路中的关键因子。结果：SXD治疗改善了矽肺大鼠的肺功能，减少了炎症细胞浸润、胶原沉积、纤维化等病理变化，并抑制了肺组织中TNF-alpha、IL-17A、IL-1beta和NF-kappaB的蛋白表达。HPLC-Q-TOF-MS结合网络药理学鉴定出关键化合物，如甘草素（Liquiritigenin）、3-甲氧基川陈皮素（3-Methoxynobiletin）、异芒果苷（Isomangiferin）、橙皮苷（Hesperidin）、姜酚（shogaol）和女贞苷（Ligustroflavone），这些化合物可能通过TNF、IL-17、NF-kappaB和TGF-beta信号通路发挥治疗作用。转录组学和代谢组学结果显示，SXD上调了NF-kappaB通路相关基因（NFKBIA、NFKBIZ）和视黄醇代谢通路关键调控因子的表达，同时下调了促炎基因（IL1B、IL17A、IL6）。实验发现证实，SXD在肺组织和细胞模型中抑制了NF-kappaB通路相关蛋白及其上游激活因子TNF-alpha、IL-17A和IL-1beta及其受体的表达。此外，含SXD血清对MRC-5细胞具有直接、无毒的作用，有效抑制胶原表达和TGF-beta分泌。SXD还对成纤维细胞中胶原产生和细胞外基质（ECM）聚集具有积极作用。分子动力学研究表明，SXD直接结合NF-kappaB和IkappaB。结论：SXD通过抑制TNF-alpha、IL-17A和IL-1beta介导的NF-kappaB信号转导，并抑制成纤维细胞活化，对矽肺纤维化发挥治疗作用。
